mapper.name: Initial Dream Email
mapper.value:
Hey {{4.`First Name`}}—

Congrats on the recent raise (I’ve seen {{7.result}} back some sharp companies in the past, so I imagine the bar was high.)
{{3.textResponse}}
Looked at your job board and noticed you're hiring for sales. If you're looking to grow your team and generate revenue quickly, outbound could be a great option.

If so - check out myoProcess, my company. We build hands-off growth systems that lets one smart growth person send personalized outbound at the scale of 50 SDRs. We're obsessed with getting the little details right so everything goes smoothly. And, our team has that scrappy startup muscle. 

3 months ago,  we helped Vention add $85k in 12 weeks by connecting them with the right people and getting them in front of decision-makers — no extra hires needed, so confident we could do something similar or better for you.
If you're interested, happy to share more on how we can help.

—Saad

mapper.name: Follow up
mapper.value:
Hey {{4.`First Name`}}—

Wanted to follow up on my previous email and make sure you saw it.

We can help you get in front of key decision-makers, making sure your outreach is effective, targeted, and efficient using AI & Automation.

Let me know if you're open to chatting about how we can help {{11.result}} with this.

—Saad

{{9.textResponse}}

mapper.name: Break up email
mapper.value:
Hey {{4.`First Name`}},

I know how busy things can get, especially with everything you’re juggling after the recent raise, so this will be my last email.

If this isn’t the right fit, no worries — just let me know if there’s someone else at Flex I should reach out to.

Thanks for your time, and best of luck with everything!

—Saad
